title: Option for showing number of grouped windows on application icon.
line: The Task Manager can now show how many windows a grouped task has, in place of the small "+" under its icon.
explanation: Grouped task buttons only drew the theme's group expander (a small "+" or arrow), which tells you there is more than one window but not how many, so an extra popup window could go unnoticed. The change adds a "Show number of windows" checkbox to the Behavior page of both Task Manager variants (off by default, next to the other grouping options). When it is on, the expander is replaced by a small badge with the window count, sized like the existing unread-count badge and placed where the expander was on every panel edge.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: add option to show the number of windows in groups

A grouped task only showed a small expander arrow, which says there is
more than one window but not how many. A new Behavior option replaces the
arrow with a small badge holding the number of windows in the group.

BUG: 405855

From a81265550c3f8c8b9b4a7ad09710fae87b598b8e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 19:44:06 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: add option to show the number of windows
 in groups

A grouped task only showed a small expander arrow, which says there is
more than one window but not how many. A new Behavior option replaces the
arrow with a small badge holding the number of windows in the group.

BUG: 405855
---
 applets/taskmanager/main.xml                  |  4 +++
 applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml    |  8 ++++-
 .../taskmanager/qml/GroupExpanderOverlay.qml  | 32 ++++++++++++++++---
 3 files changed, 38 insertions(+), 6 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/main.xml b/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
index 8c3b68785b..c7a06dc933 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
@@ -42,6 +42,10 @@
       <label>Whether to group always or only when the widget runs out of space to show additional task buttons comfortably.</label>
       <default>true</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="showGroupWindowCount" type="Bool">
+      <label>Whether grouped task buttons show the number of windows in the group instead of the group expander arrow.</label>
+      <default>false</default>
+    </entry>
     <entry name="groupingAppIdBlacklist" type="StringList">
       <label>The id's (usually .desktop file names) of applications that should not have their tasks grouped.</label>
       <default></default>
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml
index bd4b7cf008..44409ab799 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml
@@ -23,6 +23,7 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
     property alias cfg_groupedTaskVisualization: groupedTaskVisualization.currentIndex
     property alias cfg_groupPopups: groupPopups.checked
     property alias cfg_onlyGroupWhenFull: onlyGroupWhenFull.checked
+    property alias cfg_showGroupWindowCount: showGroupWindowCount.checked
     property int cfg_sortingStrategy
     property alias cfg_separateLaunchers: separateLaunchers.checked
     property alias cfg_hideLauncherOnStart: hideLauncherOnStart.checked
@@ -117,9 +118,14 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
             Accessible.onPressAction: toggle()
         }
 
+        QQC2.CheckBox {
+            id: showGroupWindowCount
+            text: i18nc("@option:check grouped task", "Show number of windows")
+            enabled: groupingStrategy.currentIndex > 0 && groupPopups.checked
+        }
+
         Item {
             Kirigami.FormData.isSection: true
-            visible: (Plasmoid.pluginName !== "org.kde.plasma.icontasks")
         }
 
         QQC2.ComboBox {
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/GroupExpanderOverlay.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/GroupExpanderOverlay.qml
index c9b85cf02e..8c0b7d64f1 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/GroupExpanderOverlay.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/GroupExpanderOverlay.qml
@@ -7,10 +7,11 @@
 import QtQuick
 
 import org.kde.plasma.core as PlasmaCore
+import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 import org.kde.ksvg as KSvg
 import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
 
-KSvg.SvgItem {
+Item {
     id: arrow
 
     anchors {
@@ -62,11 +63,32 @@ KSvg.SvgItem {
         }
     ]
 
-    implicitWidth: Math.min(naturalSize.width, iconBox.width)
-    implicitHeight: Math.min(naturalSize.height, iconBox.width)
+    implicitWidth: Plasmoid.configuration.showGroupWindowCount ? windowCount.implicitWidth : Math.min(expander.naturalSize.width, iconBox.width)
+    implicitHeight: Plasmoid.configuration.showGroupWindowCount ? windowCount.implicitHeight : Math.min(expander.naturalSize.height, iconBox.width)
 
-    imagePath: "widgets/tasks"
-    elementId: elementForLocation()
+    KSvg.SvgItem {
+        id: expander
+
+        anchors.fill: parent
+        visible: !Plasmoid.configuration.showGroupWindowCount
+
+        imagePath: "widgets/tasks"
+        elementId: arrow.elementForLocation()
+    }
+
+    Kirigami.Badge {
+        id: windowCount
+
+        readonly property real scaleFactor: Math.max(0.75, iconBox.height / Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.large)
+
+        anchors.fill: parent
+        visible: Plasmoid.configuration.showGroupWindowCount
